source: Fresh Hosted Supabase READ-ONLY schema_migrations statement read-back plus exact GitHub migration source at the pinned candidate ref.
purpose: Narrow two residual source-drift cases only. This proves whitespace/full-line-comment canonical source equivalence for an explicit two-migration allow-list. It does not prove migration-ledger identity, authorize migration repair, authorize a push/deploy, or change Country READY.

normalization_contract.method: Remove full-line SQL comments, trim, then collapse runs of whitespace to one ASCII space.
normalization_contract.scope_restriction: Only the two explicitly listed simple migrations are eligible. CI rejects block comments, dollar-quoted bodies, and quoted string/identifier literals containing whitespace before accepting this proof.

remaining_gate: Migration-ledger reconciliation plus exact credentialed supabase migration list --linked and db push --linked --dry-run evidence remain mandatory before any Hosted migration apply is considered.
